title: Nuclear receptor HR96 regulates the overexpression of multiple detoxification genes conferring resistance to indoxacarb in Spodoptera litura.
authors: Li, Wenlin; Tang, Zi; Meng, Qingqi; Wang, Hengji; Shi, Yao; Liao, Xiaolan; Shi, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究核受体转录因子SlHR96调控解毒基因过表达介导斜纹夜蛾对茚虫威抗性，涉及TF-DNA结合验证及分子对接，但核心是昆虫抗药性调控而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟为辅。
abstract: Spodoptera litura is a highly destructive and serious agricultural insect pest and has developed different degrees of resistance to various insecticides. However, the potential resistance molecular mechanisms and regulatory mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we identified and cloned a nuclear receptor transcription factor SlHR96, which was overexpressed in the indoxacarb-resistant strains and upregulated in response to indoxacarb induction. SlHR96 knockdown suppressed expression of multiple indoxacarb resistance-related detoxification genes (SlCOE050, SlCOE090, SlUGT33J17 and SlABCB3-2) and increased susceptibility to indoxacarb in S. litura. Furthermore, dual-luciferase report assays and yeast one-hybrid assays verified the binding of SlHR96 to the promoters of these detoxification genes. In addition, molecular modeling and insecticide docking showed that SlHR96 protein could bind to indoxacarb and DCJW. These results indicated that SlHR96 could sense the stress signals of indoxacarb and DCJW, and rapidly regulate the overexpression of multiple detoxification genes conferring resistance to insecticide in S. litura, which is critical for a deeper understanding of the regulatory mechanism of insecticide resistance and pest resistance management.
abstract_zh: 斜纹夜蛾（Spodoptera litura）是一种破坏性极强且严重的农业害虫，已对多种杀虫剂产生不同程度的抗性。然而，其潜在的抗性分子机制和调控机制仍不清楚。本研究鉴定并克隆了核受体转录因子SlHR96，该因子在茚虫威抗性品系中过表达，并在茚虫威诱导下表达上调。敲低SlHR96可抑制多个茚虫威抗性相关解毒基因（SlCOE050、SlCOE090、SlUGT33J17和SlABCB3-2）的表达，并增加斜纹夜蛾对茚虫威的敏感性。此外，双荧光素酶报告实验和酵母单杂交实验验证了SlHR96与这些解毒基因启动子的结合。进一步，分子建模和杀虫剂对接显示SlHR96蛋白能与茚虫威及DCJW结合。这些结果表明，SlHR96能感知茚虫威和DCJW的胁迫信号，并迅速调控多个解毒基因的过表达，从而赋予斜纹夜蛾对杀虫剂的抗性，这对于深入理解昆虫抗药性的调控机制及害虫抗性管理具有重要意义。
